record.oneLiner: FanBasis (rebranded to Commas) is an e-commerce and payment infrastructure platform providing a REST API and official MCP server for embedded checkouts, payouts, and subscription management.
record.verdictReason: FanBasis (now Commas) provides a public REST API accessible via API keys and bearer tokens, offers free self-serve account creation, features broad API breadth for merchant tools, and provides an official MCP integration.

evidence.quote:
Every API call requires a bearer token in the
Authorization header. Tokens are issued per
workspace and scoped to a set of permissions.
Anyone can now create a free account at commas.com and sell on the same infrastructure that runs businesses at nine-figure scale.
- API: Use our REST API to programmatically create and manage products
MCP beta Run Commas from your AI assistant. Create checkout links, issue refunds and pull your numbers in plain English.
